text: “Sir John d’Urberville—that’s who I am,” continued the prostrate man. “That is if knights were baronets—which they be. ’Tis recorded in history all about me. Dost know of such a place, lad, as Kingsbere-sub-Greenhill?” “Ees. I’ve been there to Greenhill Fair.” “Well, under the church of that city there lie—” “’Tisn’t a city, the place I mean; leastwise ’twaddn’ when I was there—’twas a little one-eyed, blinking sort o’ place.” “Never you mind the place, boy, that’s not the question before us.
